---
title: "Avg_GRM_self"
description: "The mean relationship within the training set; minimizing it spreads the training individuals apart."
---

The mean relationship within the training set; minimizing it spreads the training individuals apart.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | Relationship |
| Direction | Smaller is better |
| Uses a test set | no (a test set given to `optTrain()` is ignored) |
| Score a given set | `avg_grm_self_score()` |
| Search with it | `optTrain(method = "AvgGRMself")` |

## Definition

$\mathbf{1}_n' G_{TT}\mathbf{1}_n/n^2$ with $G = XX'/p$.

## Use in TSDFGS

```{r, eval = TRUE}
library(TSDFGS)
data(geno)
avg_grm_self_score(geno[1:50, ])
```

```{r, eval = TRUE}
fit <- optTrain(geno, cand = 1:404, n.train = 50, method = "AvgGRMself",
                 min.iter = 300, console = FALSE, seed = 1)
fit$OPTtrain
```

The search is a random-start exchange (hill-climbing) search; see [How the scores are computed](methods.html). Use `min.iter` larger than 300 on real data and check `fit$converged`.

## Original work

Fernández-González, J., Akdemir, D., & Isidro y Sánchez, J. (2023). A comparison of methods for training population optimization in genomic selection. *Theoretical and Applied Genetics, 136*, 30. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s00122-023-04265-6>

**Repository or website of the original authors:** Code of Fernández-González et al. (2023): [github.com/TheRocinante-lab/Publications](https://github.com/TheRocinante-lab/Publications/tree/main/2022/Fernandez-Gonzalez_et_al_2022_Comparison). Package TrainSel: [github.com/TheRocinante-lab/TrainSel](https://github.com/TheRocinante-lab/TrainSel).
